messages:
elaine: Hey team — quick access ask. I need a 2h ephemeral elevation for raj to debug a failing quantize job in the Dedicated GPU pool (job Q-12345). Will only be used for port-forward + service-account impersonation to reproduce the compile error.

raj: +1 on scope. Steps I need: `kubectl -n dedicated port-forward svc/compile 8080:8080` and `gcloud auth login --brief && gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=/tmp/sa.json && gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate ...` (I will use our short-lived SA token/STS flow).

sophie: Couple quick security checks:
- Are we sure logs won't be exported raw? any PII in stack traces?
- Need explicit justification in the break-glass form + `PII_REDACT=true` env or masking hook enabled.

elaine: Good call. I updated the Jira ticket INF-4567 with context and justification (customer X regression affecting inference latency). I've also toggled the redaction hook on the compile pod and set `PII_REDACT=true`.

oncall-bot: Policy check results: service-account SA:compile-debug@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com requires manager approval. Default TTL allowed: 2h. Last used: 1735996400. Audit logging: enabled -> sec-audit-bucket, retention 90d. Auto-approve: false.

ali: I can approve 2h if Sophie confirms redaction is enabled and Elaine will push sanitized artifacts to the audit bucket once debugging is done. :thumbsup:

sophie: Confirmed redaction hook is on and I'll review the sanitized logs after the run. Approving 2h. Please include the break-glass request link in the approval comment. :white_check_mark:

elaine: Thanks — filing formal break-glass now and tagging this thread. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4567#comment-5

raj: Starting at 16:00 UTC. Will `kubectl port-forward` and run `./local-debug --job Q-12345` then collect minimized traces. I'll post the sanitized artifact (s3://sec-audit/sanitized/Q-12345-compile.tar.gz) and a short run log here when done.

elaine: Perfect. Remember to `grep -v -E "[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}|@gmail|ssn" on any files before pushing.

raj: Will do. Quick command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n dedicated port-forward svc/compile 8080:8080 &
./local-debug --job Q-12345 --masking=on --out /tmp/q12345.log
gzip -c /tmp/q12345.log > /tmp/q12345.log.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/q12345.log.gz s3://sec-audit/sanitized/Q-12345-compile.tar.gz --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

oncall-bot: Approval recorded by ali and sophie. Elevation window: 2 hours (1736001600 - 1736008800). Audit event queued.

ali: Noted — will review artifacts once uploaded.

raj: Upload complete. Sanitized artifact: s3://sec-audit/sanitized/Q-12345-compile.tar.gz. Short sanitized log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T16:12:02Z] compile-start job=Q-12345 node=dedicated-3
[2026-03-17T16:12:05Z] loaded model shard 1/8 size=1.2GB
[2026-03-17T16:18:34Z] compile error: kernel mismatch, trying fallback kernel v2
[2026-03-17T16:20:54Z] compile success after fallback
```

sophie: Reviewing now. Thanks for the sanitized artifact. Please leave a comment in INF-4567 with the final postmortem notes.

elaine: Closing the loop here — elevation window expired, no additional access required. Logging retention and artifacts are in place.

raj: Thanks everyone.
